citation: Taylor, Zack, Jack Lucas, J.P. Kirby, and Christopher Macdonald Hewitt. 2023. “Canada’s Federal Electoral Districts, 1867–2021: New Digital Boundary Files and a Comparative Investigation of District Compactness.” Canadian Journal of Political Science 56 (2): 451–467. https://doi.org/10.1017/S0008423923000185. [Updated].

definitions.votes_first: votes: the candidate's votes as published
definitions.votes_final: none: federal contests have a single count
definitions.share_first: votes_first / sum of votes_first within the contest (equals the file's pct: cast_valid is the sum of votes)
definitions.share_final: none: federal contests have a single count
definitions.margin: share of the m-th candidate minus the (m+1)-th, m = seats won
definitions.magnitude: distmag: the seats the district returned (1, or 2 for the two-member districts to 1965), after the corrections in review/federal/FED_corrections.csv (decision 2: five 1867 contests returned one member)
definitions.formula: SMP -> FPTP (single-member plurality); two-member districts (distsystem MMP) -> block
definitions.turnout_pct: 100 * votes_total / electorate, contested FPTP contests; electors exist 1935-1968 (the printed Reports of the Chief Electoral Officer, code/F07_federal_electors.R) and from 1997 (the file), so there is no turnout before 1935 or 1972-1993
definitions.prabbrs: every jurisdiction the riding spanned, the one it is filed under (prabbr, the boundary coding) first; one except 1949 Yukon--Mackenzie River (YT;NT), from review/federal/FED_multi_jurisdiction.csv; jurisdiction_note_en/_fr says so
definitions.population: the district's population as recorded in the compiled dataset (pop), every election; a two-member district's population is the whole district's
definitions.quality: confidence rating: A on every federal contest and candidate (published and official sources, checked against one another)
definitions.dq: data point quality 5 (best) for every field and election (the brief)
definitions.unfilled: TRUE where fewer candidates won than the magnitude (none after the corrections)
definitions.person_key: internal career key: the source's candid, else a unique same-name candid career in the province, else the name within the province; regenerated every build; not exposed (nor is candid)
definitions.link_basis: as F01 sets it: candid; link table (joined to a career by the hand-edited review/federal/FED_career_links.csv); name+candid (attached to a candid career by a unique name match in the province); name
definitions.source_use: the source of each data point: lop_parlinfo (ParlInfo, the base: names, votes, winners), ec_official (Elections Canada official results, 1997-2025, where they differ or add a candidate), ceo_reports (printed CEO reports: 25 vote counts; electors 1935-1968), fed_tlkm2023 (the compiled dataset: labels run under, 34 restored candidates, electors from 1997); dq 5; n = rows
definitions.n_sources: the number of distinct sources behind the contest's names, labels, votes, winners and electors
definitions.tier: major: won the largest share of a jurisdiction's seats (ties included) in some general election; minor: otherwise won 2+ seats or 5 %+ of the votes cast in a jurisdiction in some general election; residual: the rest, and always none / other / Independent; review/atlas/party_families.csv tier column overrides
definitions.region: the file's region (Atlantic, Quebec, Ontario, Prairies, British Columbia, North)
definitions.ro_year: districts: the contest's own representation order (a few contests of 1882, 1904, 1908, 1917, 1949, 1988 and 2000 are coded to the previous one); elections / general_elections: the election's main representation order
definitions.contest_date: the contest's own polling date where it differs from the general election's (deferred polls)
definitions.incumbent: candinc as published (blank where the file has none)
definitions.name_source: the name as printed in the file (SURNAME, Given, with honorifics); name is given-first in normal case without honorifics (decisions 1 and 3)
definitions.general_elections: one row per general election: the government formed (gov_raw as printed, gov_family through the FED lookup) and the representation orders used
definitions.geometry: pending: polygons (P02) and lineages (P03) are phases F2 and F3; until then geo_role is none and geo_id / lineage_id are blank
